purpose: Teach: 鳳/鞘/英字/天秤/死語/有色/太もも/気密

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鳳凰の刺青患者の肌ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team handles skin care management for patients with phoenix tattoos.
lines.style: Clear, clinical opening. Steady professional tone. Even pacing—matter-of-fact without coldness. Direct eye contact level. Measured breathing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、手術器具の鞘ケースを医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes, the surgical instrument sheaths are managed and maintained by the entire medical team.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the voice. Patient, explanatory—teaching without condescension. Slight warmth under the clinical precision. Even rhythm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英字医学書を医療チームで輪読します
lines.en: Ren, we do group readings of English-language medical texts as a team to stay current.
lines.style: Calm, methodical delivery. Pride in the protocol without stating it. Even pace. The voice of someone who takes professional development seriously.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬剤を天秤で正確に量って医療チームで処方します
lines.en: Yes, medications are weighed with precision on the balance scale and dispensed by the team.
lines.style: Patient, thorough explanation. Clinical but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'precision'—this matters. Steady, responsible cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 死語化した医学用語を、貴院、若手に教えられてますね、先生
lines.en: You're teaching the younger staff members some of those older, less-used medical terms, aren't you, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious observation—not flattery. Soft opening. Respectful but conversational. A moment of recognition landing gently.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、有色尿の鑑別を医療チームで日々おこないます
lines.en: Yes, the team evaluates and differentiates urinary discoloration cases every single day.
lines.style: Patient, methodical. Pride in thoroughness without saying it. Even pace. The voice of someone who finds meaning in the repetitive, careful work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、太もも血管造影を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we handle all the femoral angiography procedures as part of the team's scope.
lines.style: Direct, clinical. Patient but efficient—listing a key competency. Steady professional tone. Confident without overstatement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気密室の感染症管理を、貴院、徹底されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is really rigorous about infection control in sealed clinical spaces, isn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly closer than usual. Interested observation with a touch of respect underneath. Warmer than the previous question—noticing something he values.
